I have been farming here in the North West for many years, and the land is poor, so I will put some fertilizer and manure on my small millet plot to get a better harvest. I have some schooling, so I understand that fertilizer helps, but I will use my own saved seed because improved seed is hard to find and expensive. This plot is only 0.10 hectares and I intercrop it, so my family and I can manage the work ourselves without hiring anyone. We do not irrigate millet here as we rely on the rains, and pests are not a big problem for this crop.
